reply.text:
I can't weigh in on the wrist itself. A sore wrist is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so get it looked at if it keeps bothering you or gets worse.

On the training side, I can swap barbell curls for dumbbell curls in your program. Dumbbells let each wrist sit in a more natural position, so many people find them easier on the joints. Tell me the day and I'll make the change for you to confirm, and I'll keep training around whatever a doctor or physio clears.
